definition: Exercising the Research OS loop end-to-end on a REAL research task (a live branch_contract, not a schema example or synthetic stub) to surface friction in the machinery itself — ergonomics, communication style, gate behaviour — distinct from whether the experiment's science succeeds. A single passing cycle is NOT a complete live-test; the loop is 'live-tested' only after repeated cycles stop surfacing new friction. As of 2026-06-04 the Phase-1 spine has had ONE cycle (s113) with known residual friction (verbosity); >=1 more is required before it is considered done.
